atAGlance: Bún bò Huế chay is vegetarian Huế-style spicy noodle soup, usually with lemongrass broth, thick noodles, tofu, mushrooms, and herbs.
whatItIs: Bún bò Huế chay is a vegetarian take on Huế-style lemongrass noodle soup, usually with tofu, mushrooms, vegetables, herbs, and a spicy red broth without beef.
howToEnjoy: Taste the lemongrass broth before adding chili oil, then add herbs and lime slowly. Ask about fish sauce if strict vegetarian eating matters.
howLocalsOrder: Order bún bò Huế chay and make the word chay clear. Ask for no fish sauce if you need the broth and seasoning fully vegetarian.
worthKnowing: Chay versions often recreate the aroma and noodle style of the original while replacing meat with tofu, mushrooms, and vegetable broth.
goodToKnow: Ask whether the broth is fully vegetarian and whether chili oil or seasoning is made separately from the meat version.
travelerCaution: Confirm the broth is vegetarian if strict.
